$comment: The OpenAct app directory. docs.openact.app/directory shows it, and `npm run openact -- add <id>` installs from it. To list your app, open a pull request that adds an entry with the status "available".

plans.director: Part of OpenAct Director, the paid plan for startups to midmarket companies
plans.producer: Part of OpenAct Producer, the paid plan for enterprise companies

statuses.planned: Reserved for an official app that is not ready yet

apps.name: Projects
apps.summary: Manage projects with a Kanban board, a Gantt timeline and a calendar. Includes an AI agent and search.

apps.name: Docs
apps.summary: A company library of paper-size docs, with folders, categories and tags. Live editing, comments and AI writing help. Share a doc with a link, or print it to PDF.

apps.name: Advisory
apps.summary: Run a marketplace of approved advisors. Members book consults or pay in advance through Stripe Connect, and the company keeps a fee. Each paid engagement opens a project.

apps.name: TimeTrack
apps.summary: Track time on projects and tasks. Timesheets, approvals and reports.

apps.name: Directory
apps.summary: A company directory of people, teams and roles, with search.

apps.name: Profiles
apps.summary: A profile for each person: photo, bio, skills, links and time zone.

apps.name: Groups
apps.summary: Groups and teams with members, posts and shared files.

apps.name: Tasks
apps.summary: Personal and team to-do lists that live outside projects.

apps.name: Contacts
apps.summary: People and companies outside your company. A light CRM with notes and follow-ups.

apps.name: Events
apps.summary: Events with sign-ups, reminders and a shared calendar.

apps.name: Booking
apps.summary: Weekly availability, Google and Microsoft calendar busy times, and booking links. Other apps, such as Advisory, add a Pick a time step.

apps.name: Learn
apps.summary: Courses and lessons, with progress for each person.

apps.name: Workflow
apps.summary: Approvals and automations that run across apps.

apps.name: Support
apps.summary: A help desk: tickets, replies and a help center.

apps.name: Hello
apps.summary: Company notes. The smallest complete app: a table, an API route, a permission and a page. Copy it to start your own.

apps.name: Orbytt (mockup)
apps.summary: Find remote talent in the US and the Philippines, and hire them as contractors on your projects. A mockup of a planned app.
